data.name: Epp
data.gender_notes: Epp is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'epi' meaning 'upon' and 'phe' meaning 'to do'. Epp represents the grace that comes upon us from the divine. The name Epp carries the meaning “Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Epp usually hope their child will grow to embody grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's grace and presence in our lives.
data.etymology: Epp belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Epp total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_latin.name: Epp
